Delivered. Commit 56a55c4 "Match a quote across line endings when editing a file" (6 files, +463/-99) is on main and pushed to origin/main (7e6f799..56a55c4).

The commit carries the line-ending matcher, the broker tests, the trimmed miss diagnostics and the bundled edit_file instruction change as one reviewable change. Tests were re-run after the final edits: 19 file_access_tests and 11 line_endings tests pass; the full desktop lib suite was 646 passed / 0 failed / 1 ignored, and clippy reports nothing in the new or changed files.

The Adashi records this work produced (task #214, the files.edit memory note, task #215 itself) follow in the record-sync commit on the same branch.

data.description: Deliver task #214 to origin/main: commit the line-ending matcher, its broker tests and the bundled edit_file instruction change as one reviewable change, then sync the Adashi records it produced (task #214, memory note) in the project's usual record-sync commit and push both.
data.title: Commit and push the files.edit line-ending fix
